##### Project general facts

Gianfranco Ferre Residences brings iconic Italian design to the prestigious shores of Al Marjan Island, offering a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, including exclusive residences with private terrace pools. Designed in a distinctive U-shaped configuration, the development ensures that every home enjoys uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf, seamlessly combining sophisticated architecture, contemporary comfort, and a resort-inspired waterfront lifestyle.

The development offers an exceptional selection of lifestyle amenities designed to promote relaxation, wellness, and everyday luxury. Residents can enjoy rooftop wellness facilities, panoramic swimming pools, a dedicated family pool, beautifully landscaped gardens, sun decks, and a state-of-the-art fitness center equipped for Pilates, CrossFit, and cycling. Complementing these facilities are premium hotel-style services, including a 24-hour concierge, valet parking, housekeeping, security, a stylish lobby café, luxury retail outlets, and two fine-dining restaurants, creating a truly elevated residential experience.

Each residence is finished to the highest standards using premium-quality materials and is equipped with an advanced Smart Home system for enhanced comfort and convenience. The apartments feature fully equipped kitchens and come fully furnished with exclusive interiors by the renowned Italian fashion house Gianfranco Ferre, delivering a turnkey living experience that perfectly reflects the project's distinctive blend of luxury, craftsmanship, and timeless elegance.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago located in the emirate of Ras Al Khaimah. It is one of the most prominent tourist destinations in the region, known for its picturesque beaches, luxurious resorts, and upscale residential developments. Al Marjan Island is situated along the Arabian Gulf coastline and offers breathtaking views of the sea. The island is shaped like a coral reef and is made up of four primary coral-shaped islands, connected by a central boulevard.

One of the main highlights of Al Marjan Island is its pristine white sandy beaches that stretch across 5.4 kilometers. Visitors can indulge in various beach activities, including sunbathing, swimming, and water sports such as jet skiing and paddleboarding. The crystal-clear waters of the Arabian Gulf provide an ideal setting for water enthusiasts.

Al Marjan Island boasts a collection of luxurious hotels and resorts, offering world-class amenities and services. These accommodations cater to both leisure and business travelers, providing a range of options to suit different preferences and budgets. Many of the hotels and resorts on the island feature stunning architecture and provide access to private beaches, swimming pools, spas, and gourmet dining options.
